notes: Strip b: x 3080-4640 with overlap to 2780-4940. Reading Road centre taken on its streetcar tracks. Solid lines down the middle of several streets are water pipes, not curbs. Names: Eugenia/Redway/Marion/Burton/Lexington/Glenwood/Dana carry the suffix only in a second label away from the name; 'Lenox' here is the same street as Lenox Place. Dakota Avenue: the N-S part (60 ft) prints only 'AVE.', the curved part 'DAKOTA'; joined on continuous house numbers 3895-3800. The N-S road from the Dana/Winding junction south to the triangular island has no name printed (only 'CITY OF CINCINNATI' boundary lettering); taken as Dana Avenue because Dana labels sit at both ends. Not streets: spaced lettering ROSE HILL, MITCHELL ARMSTRONG'S SUBD., DENMAN'S ESTATE, the vertical 'ESTATE' letters east of Glen Lyon, DAYTON'S ESTATE, the 'C O N...' and 'R W I N S' lettering; the grey/pink/yellow/blue boundary bands (along Glen Lyon, x~3880, x~4110, y~6290); sewers; the dashed lines in the Victory park area. Valley Lane and Winding Way also meet east of this strip (x~5300).
